_comment: Display metadata for the knowledge domains in this corpus. Optional: a domain with no entry here falls back to a title-cased version of its folder name. Groups are used to organise the domain picker in the UIs.

order_service.label: Order Service
order_service.description: Order lifecycle, state machine, inventory reservation and the order API.
faqs: What are the valid order state transitions?
How does idempotency work when creating an order?
What happens if the Payment Service is unreachable?
How long is inventory reserved for an unpaid order?
Which events does the Order Service publish?

payment_service.label: Payment Service
payment_service.description: Provider abstraction, authorize/capture, refunds, retries and reconciliation.
faqs: How is a payment provider selected for an order?
What is the difference between authorize and capture?
Which payment errors are safe to retry?
How does the circuit breaker behave during a provider outage?
Why is a payment stuck in PENDING?

identity_verification_service.label: Identity Verification
identity_verification_service.description: Assurance levels, verification steps, the decision engine and manual review.
faqs: What are the assurance levels and how do they differ?
How does the decision engine choose between approve, reject and review?
What happens when a verification session expires?
How is verification evidence stored and retained?
When is a session routed to manual review?

notification_service.label: Notification Service
notification_service.description: Event-driven delivery, templates, preferences, rate limits and retries.
faqs: How are domain events mapped to notification templates?
Which notifications can a customer opt out of?
What are the per-customer rate limits?

How does suppression work after a hard bounce?

workflow_engine.label: Workflow Engine
workflow_engine.description: Workflow graphs, execution model, waiting steps, compensation and versioning.
faqs: How does the engine decide when a step can run?
What happens to a run when a step fails?
How do waiting steps and signals work?
Why must handlers be idempotent?
How does workflow versioning affect in-flight runs?
